mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP450 enzymes (chlorpromazine via CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP3A4; albendazole via CYP3A4) with potential for metabolic competition, and both can cause CNS depression and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor liver function tests periodically; use with caution in patients with hepatic impairment; counsel on CNS depression risks and avoid concurrent use of other sedating agents when possible.
